section.div: Favorites genres: Comedy, Action, Fantasy, Romance

div.div: Year 198 of the Solar Era in Tokyo, special fire brigades are fighting against a phenomenon called spontaneous human combustion where human beings are turned into living infernos called "Infernals.” While the Infernals are first-generation cases of spontaneous human combustion, later generations possess the ability to manipulate flames while retaining human form. Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil’s Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shinra begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago. (Source: Official Website)
Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season Part 2

The war for Paradis zeroes in on Shiganshina just as Jaegerists have seized control. After taking a huge blow from a surprise attack led by Eren, Marley swiftly acts to return the favor. With Zeke’s true plan revealed and a military forced under new rule, this battle might be fought on two fronts. Does Eren intend on fulfilling his half-brother’s wishes or does he have a plan of his own?
(Source: Funimation)

The members of the Gourmet Guild—Yuuki, Kokkoro, Pecorine, and Karyl—continue to scour the world in pursuit of their goal to seek out all delicious food in existence. However, as their adventures progress, the mysteries behind Yuuki's memories, Karyl's allegiance, and Pecorine's heritage begin to come together—seemingly forming the truth that makes up the world's very foundation.
(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Sajou Wataru, who is deeply in love with his beautiful classmate Natsukawa Aika, is continuing to approach her without getting discouraged while having dreams about their mutual love. However one day he woke up thinking "I am not really fit to be together with someone as good as her, huh..." Upon realizing this, Wataru started keeping an appropriate distance towards her, much to Aika's surprise. "Could it be that he hates me now...?" Did his intentions slip by her because she was getting impatient after arriving at the wrong conclusion!? This is the start of a romcom revolving around two people who just can't get their feelings across and both think their love is unrequited!

Hina, Asahi's older sister's best friend, is always hanging around the house he shares with his sister. She's unbelievably beautiful, irresistibly cute... and has absolutely no sense of personal space. Before he knows it, Asahi—a nerdy high school boy—is completely swept up into her antics. A gorgeous trendy girl with no concept of boundaries and a dependable, doting high school boy... They're both hopelessly in love with each other, yet neither can bring themselves to confess in this sweet, frustratingly adorable romance! (Source: MANGA MILLION)

Our protagonist was reincarnated in a world with goblin and dragon... but his optimal job is "villager". Using the cheat "getting one chance to redo life after death" he will show you what a villager can do. Included chapters: 9.5
